actual_own_training_errors_before_update: See parent32 original-member failure decomposition, not the current eight-case endpoint.

any_phrases: identified at the time of disclosure
does not need to be identified
reduced to writing by disclosing party
designated as confidential at the time of disclosure
marked confidential or should be deemed
all information received shall be considered confidential information
whether it be marked confidential or not
regardless of whether such information is specifically identified as confidential

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select clauses making marking, designation, notice, or a default rule govern confidentiality; include the governing definition and alternatives. Exclude mere document labels and unrelated notice provisions.

operations.rationale: Observed omissions and role errors persist despite visible marking clauses, especially where confidentiality follows notification, objective treatment, or a default rule. The generalized additions replace party-specific wording and publish the corresponding selection criterion.

any_phrases: no right or license is granted
does not grant any implied intellectual property licenses
grant data recipient any intellectual property rights or licenses
retain title and all ownership rights

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select operative clauses addressing rights in confidential information or related intellectual property: no-license, ownership, reserved-rights, or express limited grants. Include exceptions only when they define the grant's scope.

operations.rationale: Visible ownership and reserved-rights members were repeatedly omitted or displaced by nearby limited-use language. The criterion distinguishes direct rights provisions from context while preserving express grants that delimit scope.

any_phrases: existence and terms of this agreement
existence or contents of this agreement
public announcement of or otherwise disclose the existence
fact that the parties hereto are considering
public statement concerning the existence of this agreement

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select definitions or operative nondisclosure clauses covering the agreement's existence or contents, negotiations, or transaction discussions; include linked definition and prohibition. Exclude entire-agreement boilerplate and unrelated publicity.

operations.rationale: Multiple direct hits defining discussions or agreement existence as confidential were visible but unused. The criterion identifies responsive definition and prohibition clauses while separating boilerplate references to the agreement.

any_phrases: share confidential data with persons having authorized access
employees independent contractors advisors or affiliates
will not disclose any confidential information
make no disclosures of any confidential information
not to use or disclose to another person
may be disclosed only to employees or contractors
not disclose to any third party except

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select the operative disclosure or access clause and recipient definitions it invokes. Distinguish employees from nonemployee representatives, advisers, agents, or contractors; exclude responsibility and security clauses standing alone.

operations.rationale: Employee-only, authorized-access, and contrary nondisclosure clauses were frequently accessible yet omitted, while some nearby restrictions were mistaken for sharing evidence. Added compact recipient wording and a category-sensitive selection criterion.

any_phrases: written notice of such legal requirement
give the discloser as much notice
provide the other party with prompt notice
give to the other written notice
written notice of the order or request
as soon as reasonably possible of the required disclosure

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select a clause coupling legally compelled disclosure with notice to the source, owner, or contractual counterpart entitled to notice; include separated trigger and notice language. Exclude unrelated breach notices.

operations.rationale: The lawyer confused notification roles and omitted visible compelled-disclosure duties. Party-specific vocabulary was removed in favor of portable timing language, and the criterion requires the legal trigger and proper notice recipient.

any_phrases: standard electronic backup and archival procedures
except as may be otherwise required by law
no copy thereof shall be retained
no copies will be made or retained
without retaining in whole or in part any copies
may retain such of its documents
shall not be deemed to have retained
records department may retain one copy
except for copies of any computer records or electronic files
return or destroy all the other party's confidential information

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select express post-return or destruction retention permission or prohibition, including backup, archive, legal-retention, and no-copy terms. Include the return duty only when needed to establish timing or scope.

operations.rationale: Retention outcomes were often inferred from generic return language, while explicit backup, archive, legal-retention, and no-copy members were missed. Added recurrent formulations and a criterion separating the retention witness from its trigger.

any_phrases: rightfully received by the receiving party
acquired by data recipient from a source other than
later acquired by the receiving party
available on a non-confidential basis from a source
received from another source who can disclose it lawfully
independently received from a third party

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select an exception or permission for information received or acquired from an independent third-party source, together with lawful, rightful, or no-confidentiality conditions. Exclude representative disclosure and independent-development clauses.

operations.rationale: Several recurring non-confidential-source formulations were visible but not selected, and independent development or representative sharing was sometimes substituted. The additions and criterion isolate third-party acquisition conditions.

guidance.evidence_criterion: Select operative prohibitions on reverse engineering, decompiling, disassembling, or systematic recreation of protected material. Include scope-limiting exceptions; exclude ordinary copying, reproduction, disclosure, or confidentiality language alone.

operations.rationale: A directly matched systematic-recreation witness was omitted, while unrelated oral, copying, and confidentiality text generated false relations elsewhere. The published criterion separates reverse-engineering conduct from adjacent restrictions.
